label: Program name
help: The offer or tool you are tracking.

label: Provider
help: The company or organization behind it.

label: Category
help: AI API, Cloud, Startup, Education, Nonprofit, Local / open source, or Other.

label: What you get
help: A short, factual summary of the free allowance.

label: Eligibility
help: Who qualifies. Write 'verify' when you are unsure.

label: Official URL
help: The provider's own page, not an affiliate link.

label: Date checked
help: The date you last reviewed the terms (YYYY-MM-DD).

label: Account email
help: Use a dedicated business email you control.

label: Project or org ID
help: Workspace, project, org, or account identifier.

label: Start date
help: When the trial or credit began (YYYY-MM-DD).

label: Credit expires
help: When the credit expires, if known.

label: Card on file
help: yes or no. A card changes the risk.

label: Auto-renew date
help: When a subscription renews or a trial converts.

label: Decide by
help: The date you will keep, downgrade, or cancel, before renewal.

label: Cancel or downgrade URL
help: The exact settings or help page you will need.

label: Monthly budget
help: Your internal cap, even if the provider has no hard limit.

label: Alert threshold
help: The alert percentage you configured, such as 25, 50, 75, or 90.

label: Status
help: researching, active, expired, cancelled, or paid.

label: Notes
help: Data-use caveats, usage observations, support contact, or a cancellation confirmation number.
